## What this PR does

Short summary, one sentence per change.

## Why

The user need or bug being addressed. Link the issue with `Closes #N` if applicable.

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run check` is green locally.
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a Vitest test (failing-first, then passing).
- [ ] Manual smoke against `npm run dev`: …

## Checklist

- [ ] No new file exceeds ~400 lines.
- [ ] No new dependencies added (or, if added, justified in the description).
- [ ] No `console.log` on hot paths.
- [ ] Commit messages follow `<type>: <subject>` (`fix:`, `feat:`, `audit:`, `chore:`, …).
